purpose: Second hidden reference authored from task.md plus the PUBLIC code alone. For this underspecified-by-design fixture the question is whether the in-repo conventions pin every graded choice: an independent author exploring the workspace must converge on the same behavior.
authoring_protocol: Written from task.md and public/src only, without reading the primary reference or the grader. At every decision point the author looked for an in-repo convention (docstring, shared helper, a migrated source, a consumer's own registry) before choosing.

interpretations.template-choice: core/normalize.py MIGRATION note ('Every NEW source starts on house_flow; never copy the inline flow out of alpha_feed or beta_feed') pins gamma/delta as the template, not the alphabetically-first alpha
interpretations.row-shape: core/rows.py ('consumers index event rows by POSITION') plus positions_report's ReportError pin position-indexed tuples through make_event_row
interpretations.correction-kind: core/changelog.py ('kinds are a CLOSED vocabulary', restatement = NEW row) plus audit_trail's replay assertion pin correction -> restate as an appended row
interpretations.as-of-date: core/dates.py pins as_of = released (published), never in_force (effective)
interpretations.identity-state: core/identity.py pins the event_id state hash over (kind, published_at, effective_at) so re-scrapes dedup and corrections append
interpretations.error-payload: alpha/beta/gamma/delta all fail loudly on error-shaped or empty payloads; epsilon's non-OK envelope status follows the same rule
interpretations.venue-entry: reference/venues.py ('every ingesting source must have a VENUES entry') plus venue_dashboard's silent skip pin the registry entry
interpretations.scheduler-shell: scheduler/registry.py ('every ingesting source has a thin shell ... BEFORE run_resolution') plus run_resolution's staleness warning pin the shell and its block placement
interpretations.export-section: exposure_export.SOURCE_SECTIONS docstring ('every ingesting source must be added') pins the section entry
interpretations.alert-channel: alerts.VENUE_CHANNELS docstring ('every venue that can halt trading needs a channel') pins the channel entry; the channel VALUE is a free choice (desk-emea here, desk-eu in the primary)
interpretations.scope: pipeline.py ('Only sources with a working parser are registered here; scrape-only stubs stay unregistered') overrides PLAN.md's roster instruction; the stubs and PLAN.md's sigma template are decoys

pre_reconciliation_result.conclusion: Every graded expectation was reachable from a discoverable in-repo convention without reading the hidden grader.

reconciliation: No reconciliation was needed: the independent reading converged on the convention-pinned semantics at zero provider cost.
interpretation_differences_after_pinning: None by design. Remaining differences are structural and free-choice values only.
structural_differences: field translation via a _FIELDS tuple table instead of inline dict literals
kind mapping through a complete _KINDS dict instead of a single-override dict
per-record work concentrated in a _translate helper called from a list comprehension
guard clause style (single if with 'not already_recorded') instead of continue-based loop
epsilon scheduled earlier inside the sources block (position within the block is documented as not significant)
different free-choice values: venue display name/country/tz, export section label, alert channel (desk-emea vs desk-eu)
